## About
Modern Imports sells recycled auto parts for imports and American cars, from Acura and BMW to Ford, Chevrolet, Toyota and Volvo. A good used part can save you real money over buying new.
This isn't a pick and pull yard. You tell us what you need, put down a deposit, and we pull it for you. Our inventory changes regularly, so it's worth calling to check what we have.
Shops and drivers around St. Louis call us for parts. We're rated 4.1 from 246 Google reviews.

## Services
- Recycled auto parts: Used parts for imports and American makes, including Honda, Jeep, Lexus, Mercedes, Nissan, Subaru, Volkswagen and more.
- VIN decoder: Not sure exactly what you have? Decode your car's VIN on our site before you look for parts.

## FAQ
Q: Can I pull my own parts?
A: No. We're not a pick and pull yard. You'll put a deposit down for the part you're looking for and we take it from there.

Q: Do you carry parts for American cars too?
A: Yes. Despite the name, we carry parts for imports and American makes like Buick, Cadillac, Chrysler, Dodge, Ford and Lincoln.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
